mapper.select: SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM spots WHERE status = 1) AS spot_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM place_groups WHERE COALESCE(route_graph_status, 'none') IN ('draft', 'verified')) AS route_scope_count, ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM pois WHERE status = 1 AND COALESCE(area_code, '') != 'route' AND COALESCE(area_code, '') != 'campus_summary' ) AS poi_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM route_edges) AS route_edge_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM users WHERE status = 1) AS user_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM foods WHERE status = 1) AS food_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM travel_logs WHERE status = 1) AS log_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM circles WHERE status = 1) AS circle_count

SELECT s.id AS spot_id, s.legacy_place_group_id AS place_group_id, s.representative_poi_id AS representative_poi_id, s.name, s.spot_type AS spot_type, s.province, s.city, s.status, COALESCE(pg.route_graph_status, 'none') AS route_graph_status, COUNT(DISTINCT vp.id) AS visible_poi_count, COUNT(DISTINCT str.tag_id) AS tag_count, CASE WHEN s.category_id IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS missing_category, CASE WHEN s.cover_image IS NULL OR s.cover_image = '' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS missing_cover, CASE WHEN s.longitude IS NULL OR s.latitude IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS missing_geo, CASE WHEN s.short_name IS NULL OR s.short_name = '' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS missing_short_name, CASE WHEN s.description IS NULL OR s.description = '' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS missing_description, CASE WHEN s.address IS NULL OR s.address = '' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS missing_address, CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT str.tag_id) = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS missing_tags, CASE WHEN s.representative_poi_id IS NULL OR rp.id IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS missing_representative_poi, CASE WHEN rp.id IS NOT NULL AND rp.status != 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS representative_poi_disabled, CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT vp.id) = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS missing_visible_poi, CASE WHEN s.spot_type IN ('campus', 'university') AND COALESCE(pg.route_graph_status, 'none') = 'none' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS campus_route_missing FROM spots s LEFT JOIN place_groups pg ON pg.id = s.legacy_place_group_id LEFT JOIN pois rp ON rp.id = s.representative_poi_id LEFT JOIN pois vp ON vp.spot_id = s.id AND vp.status = 1 AND COALESCE(vp.area_code, '') NOT IN ('route', 'campus_summary', 'spot_summary') LEFT JOIN spot_tag_relations str ON str.spot_id = s.id WHERE s.status = 1 GROUP BY s.id, s.legacy_place_group_id, s.representative_poi_id, s.name, s.spot_type, s.province, s.city, s.status, pg.route_graph_status, s.category_id, s.cover_image, s.longitude, s.latitude, s.short_name, s.description, s.address, rp.id, rp.status ORDER BY (missing_representative_poi + representative_poi_disabled + missing_geo + missing_visible_poi + campus_route_missing) DESC, (missing_cover + missing_category + missing_short_name + missing_description + missing_address + missing_tags) DESC, s.id ASC LIMIT 80

SELECT pg.id AS place_group_id, pg.name, COALESCE(pg.route_graph_status, 'none') AS route_graph_status, COUNT(DISTINCT pgm.id) AS map_count, MAX(pgm.map_width) AS map_width, MAX(pgm.map_height) AS map_height FROM place_groups pg LEFT JOIN place_group_maps pgm ON pgm.place_group_id = pg.id WHERE COALESCE(pg.route_graph_status, 'none') IN ('draft', 'verified') GROUP BY pg.id, pg.name, pg.route_graph_status ORDER BY pg.id ASC

SELECT p.id, p.spot_id AS spotId, p.place_group_id AS placeGroupId, p.name, c.code AS categoryCode, c.name AS categoryName, p.area_code AS areaCode, p.area_name AS areaName, p.longitude, p.latitude, p.map_x AS mapX, p.map_y AS mapY FROM pois p JOIN poi_categories c ON c.id = p.category_id WHERE p.place_group_id = #{placeGroupId} AND p.status = 1 AND COALESCE(p.area_code, '') != 'campus_summary' ORDER BY CASE WHEN p.area_code = 'route' THEN 2 ELSE 1 END, p.id ASC

SELECT e.id, e.from_poi_id AS fromPoiId, e.to_poi_id AS toPoiId, e.distance_m AS distanceM, e.duration_min AS durationMin, e.transport_type AS transportType, e.is_indoor AS indoor, e.description FROM route_edges e LEFT JOIN pois fp ON fp.id = e.from_poi_id LEFT JOIN pois tp ON tp.id = e.to_poi_id WHERE fp.place_group_id = #{placeGroupId} AND tp.place_group_id = #{placeGroupId} AND fp.status = 1 AND tp.status = 1 ORDER BY e.id ASC
